comment: Shared vectors for the C2-R1b ruled fork-choice comparison and the
CEN-D5 alt-window selection (docs/design/CONSENSUS_C2_R1_REORG.md §4b,
ratified 2026-09-03):
Fork choice: the best chain is decided at alt admission by STRICTLY
greater cumulative difficulty — equality keeps the incumbent; an
operator-checkpoint match on the alternative forces the switch
regardless of difficulty. verdict 0 = keep current, 1 = switch.
Cumulative difficulties are given as lo/hi u64 halves (the FFI ABI).
Alt window: for a candidate at bei_height whose stored alt ancestry
has alt_len blocks starting at first_alt_height, the LWMA window is
filled from the main-chain range [main_start, main_stop) plus the
newest alt_take entries of the alt chain, totalling
min(N + 1, bei_height) with N = 90. refused = true marks the
fail-closed preconditions (height-0 candidate; discontiguous
ancestry).
Consumers: rust/shekyl-difficulty/tests/fork_choice_vectors.rs pins
the ONE implementation natively over both sections, and C++
tests/unit_tests/fork_choice_vectors.cpp pins the same sections
end-to-end through the FFI (shekyl_difficulty_fork_choice /
shekyl_difficulty_alt_window_plan) the block-connect machinery
consumes.
Vectors are pinned per rule 30: a change here is a consensus change
and requires review + a CHANGELOG entry.

alt_window_cases.comment: Selection plans; totals always min(91, bei_height) unless refused.
